_doc: Judge notes (written by the human/LLM judge after looking at program/compare.jpg + cartoon.html). Style decisions live here; the metric only enforces a fidelity budget. Keys: lines (bool), line_max (int), line_focal_min (0 = lines anywhere), style_budget (max relative loss increase), smooth (contour blur px), verdict, notes[].

3603f621-18f4-4711-ab93-946cab123329_0.verdict: PASS. The four towers read clearly, and the warm-vs-violet glow contrast survives. Strong silhouette staging.
notes: lattice towers became solid slabs with holes; structure lines help, but a lattice really wants a hatch/cross pattern fill
ground plane is one flat red mass, which works as a stage floor

3a0da51b-4c03-45a0-bf3f-d03e5092c4be_0.verdict: PASS (best of six). Reads like a painted background plate: haze gradient, light pools, three walkers in silhouette.
notes: ceiling lights became soft blobs; fine as a style, could be crisp ellipses + glow

7fae27c3-7bd0-4f8b-805b-4ccd740595b2_0.verdict: FAIL. Overhead crowd plaza collapses into blob soup. The concentric ring structure, which is the whole design, is lost.
notes: needs radial/concentric structure (circle fits, not straight LSD lines)
the crowd should be a stipple texture layer, not traced shapes
plane map put 71% of the frame in P4, so the semantic seed had too little to work with

d3d25411-5610-40fd-ad76-e36a25eca80c_1.verdict: PASS. The semantic seed reads as a designed corridor (ceiling/walls/stair block/water), and the 9 silhouettes are strong. The colour seed (round 1) scored better on ΔE but looked like camouflage blotches, so it was rejected.
notes: step lines now on the stairs (round 5)
ceiling lost its bright panel pattern; acceptable for a cartoon
water reflections still blotchy; horizontal streak convention would read better than traced patches

e9c68c53-270a-40d3-be47-b19b47b4068c_0.verdict: PARTIAL → better. Round 2: frame-wide structure lines restore the receding deck planks, so the perspective now reads (edge F 0.36→0.39 within a 3% fidelity budget). The laundry reads well with real fabric colours. The star-field sky is still flat grey.
notes: allow structure lines across the whole frame so the deck planks converge
sky needs a star stipple layer; pixel metrics will always reject it, so it must be a judge-requested style layer

ef9f6c7e-e507-421d-b028-2d76f14d0c11_3.verdict: PASS. Wall, lit stairs, water and distant mountains are clean masses; the sky gradient is right.
notes: the child (P2, to be drawn) is still missing; place them on the stairs
stars lost (same stipple issue as Ankhu)
